subject: Non-US supplier: taxed services — PO tagging & evidence flow
messages:
From: Emma Holt <emma.holt@novaterra.co.uk>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 08:14:00 +0100
Subject: Tax treatment question for upcoming PO / sample invoice attached

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the quick chat earlier. We're finalising the first invoice batch for professional services delivered to Redwood EMEA and need to confirm how you want VAT/GST handled on your side so our AP team formats invoices correctly and the PO metadata aligns. Two short items: 

1) Our services are performed in the UK but billed to Redwood Ireland entity. In most cases we expect reverse-charge treatment (zero-rated to us, VAT accounted for by the buyer), but we need confirmation which legal entity (Redwood Ireland or Redwood US) will hold the PO and whether you require a VAT registration number on the invoice.

2) Can your procurement system accept a flag on the PO for "reverse-charge" services so finance can route to the correct GL (tax-accrual) and avoid automatic VAT withholdings in the AP hub?

I've attached a sample invoice CSV and a short tax attestation PDF from our UK tax lead. [Attachment: Novaterra_Invoice_Sample_UK.csv] [Attachment: Novaterra_Tax_Attestation.pdf]

Appreciate a quick note on the PO tagging and any additional evidence you require (VAT number, proof of place of supply, signed W-8/EU form, local fiscal representative info, etc.).

Best,
Emma
Emma Holt
Head of Finance Operations, Novaterra Ltd.
emma.holt@novaterra.co.uk
+44 20 7946 0123

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Holt <emma.holt@novaterra.co.uk>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tax treatment question for upcoming PO / sample invoice attached

Emma — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments, very helpful. A few quick answers and next steps from procurement & finance perspective: 

- Legal entity for PO: We will issue the PO from Redwood Ireland (Redwood AI EMEA Ltd) for services billed to EMEA. I'll confirm the exact PO entity id once procurement creates the purchase order.

- PO flagging: Yes — we can add a PO-level custom field "tax_handling": values={"standard_vat","reverse_charge","withholding"}. Finance prefers the value "reverse_charge" for your case so the AP system routes to the tax-accrual workflow. We'll also add a secondary boolean field "requires_vat_certificate" if finance requests proof.

- Evidence: Please include your UK VAT registration number on the invoice where possible. Additionally, a short signed attestation confirming place-of-supply and that the supplier is not charging VAT (reverse-charge) is sufficient for our records. The attached PDF looks close — finance will confirm if they need company seal or signature.

- Practical ask: Can you resend the CSV with a column for "supplier_vat_number" and one for "place_of_supply_country"? Also, confirm whether Novaterra prefers the PO to be sent to the UK AP mailbox or the central Redwood EMEA AP queue.

I'll loop in Laura (finance ops) for final confirmation on tax evidence and Ben (vendor onboarding) to set the PO metadata. Expect a follow-up by Monday with the PO id.

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Sourcing Manager, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai

From: Novaterra AP Team <ap@novaterra.co.uk>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:18:00 +0100
Subject: Novaterra — updated invoice CSV and VAT number

Hi Connor / Laura,

Attached is the requested CSV with the added columns: supplier_vat_number and place_of_supply_country. Our UK VAT number is GB123456789. We will issue invoices to Redwood AI EMEA Ltd and confirm the AP mailbox: please route the PO and remittance advice to emea-ap@redwood.ai.

For clarity: Novaterra confirms services were supplied in the UK and we are NOT charging VAT on these invoices, requesting reverse-charge treatment by the buyer. The attached tax attestation has been re-signed by our tax director and includes company registration info. [Attachment: Novaterra_Invoice_Sample_UK.csv] [Attachment: Novaterra_Tax_Attestation.pdf]

If you need a notarised declaration or fiscal representative contact, we can provide as a follow-up — let us know which is preferred for your audit trail.

Regards,
Novaterra AP Team
ap@novaterra.co.uk

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Novaterra — updated invoice CSV and VAT number

Laura / Ben — forwarding Novaterra's update. Key actions I propose: 

1) Finance (Laura): confirm that Novaterra's GB VAT (GB123456789) + signed attestation satisfy our evidence requirements for reverse-charge accounting. If yes, mark vendor as "reverse_charge_approved" and set requires_vat_certificate=false. If not, request notarised attestation or fiscal rep contact.

2) Vendor onboarding (Ben): create vendor record under Redwood AI EMEA Ltd, set PO custom field tax_handling=reverse_charge, and ensure emea-ap@redwood.ai is set as the preferred AP mailbox for POs and remittance. Also attach the PDF to the vendor record. Quote me the vendor id once created so I can confirm the PO.

3) Edge case: If finance decides this should be treated as domestic VAT for any reason, we need a short SOP on how to handle retroactive tax accruals for previously paid invoices. Prefer to avoid this — please advise.

I can draft the PO after Ben confirms vendor id. Happy to jump on a 15-min sync if helpful.

Thanks,
Connor
